outages.description: Armstrong (AS27364) customers in Pennsylvania, Ohio, New York and Kentucky experienced a brief Internet outage.
A failure of equipment in the mobile core network of Orange (AS3215) caused a nationwide mobile network outage in France
A technical problem at Google Cloud caused elevated errors and network failures for multiple services in its europe-west2 (London) region
Announced maintenance by Syrian Telecom (AS29256) caused a significant drop in Internet traffic across multiple providers in Syria
Disruptions after data center drone strike
Super Typhoon Champi caused widespread disruptions to Internet traffic across Guam.
A nationwide power outage caused a significant drop in Internet traffic in Sri Lanka
A loss of generation at the Randolph Harley Power Plant caused a significant drop in Internet traffic on St. Thomas and St. John.
Yandex, Russia's biggest internet company, shut down its data centers in Sasovo, Ryazan, and later in Vladimir after drone strikes damaged both facilities.
